# Zenra AI

> Software studio that builds custom AI tools, websites, online stores and blockchain apps for businesses worldwide, and makes its own Windows apps for creators (Zenra AI Viral Clips, Zenra Video Downloader, Zenra Video Splitter).

Contact: support@zenraai.com — project inquiries: https://zenraai.com/contact/

## Services
- [Services — AI Tools, Websites, E-commerce & More | Zenra AI](https://zenraai.com/services/): AI tool development, website development, e-commerce, Facebook and Instagram marketing and blockchain development for businesses worldwide.
- [AI Tool Development — Custom AI Assistants & Automation | Zenra AI](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-tool-development/): Custom AI assistants, document processing, workflow automation and AI-powered apps — built around your data and workflow, with a fixed quote.
- [AI Website Development — Fast, SEO-Ready Websites | Zenra AI](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-website-development/): Fast, search-ready business websites with useful AI features: AI chat from your own content, smart search and lead tracking. Fixed quote.
- [E-commerce Development — Shopify & WooCommerce Stores | Zenra AI](https://zenraai.com/services/ecommerce-development/): Shopify and WooCommerce stores built to sell: design, payments, shipping, product catalogs and month-to-month store management for brands worldwide.
- [Facebook & Instagram Marketing — Reels & Meta Ads | Zenra AI](https://zenraai.com/services/facebook-instagram-marketing/): Facebook and Instagram marketing measured in leads and sales: content and Reels, Meta ads, conversion tracking and clear monthly reports.
- [Blockchain Development — Smart Contracts & dApps | Zenra AI](https://zenraai.com/services/blockchain-development/): Smart contracts, ERC-20 and NFT tokens, staking, vesting and wallet-connected dApps on Ethereum and EVM chains — tested and built on proven standards.

## Products
- [Products — Viral Clips, Video Downloader & Splitter | Zenra AI](https://zenraai.com/tools/): Windows apps by Zenra AI: Viral Clips turns long videos into shorts, Video Downloader saves videos in 4K, and Video Splitter splits videos for free.
- [Zenra AI Viral Clips — Turn Long Videos Into Viral Shorts With AI](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-ai-viral-clips/): Windows app that turns long videos into viral 9:16 clips: finds the best moments, keeps the speaker in frame, adds captions and titles. 30-day free trial.
- [Zenra Video Downloader — Videos, Playlists & Channels in 4K](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-downloader/): Windows video downloader for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and Snapchat. Download playlists and whole channels in bulk, in up to 4K or MP3. 1-day free trial.
- [Zenra Video Splitter — Split Any Video Into Equal Clips (Free)](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-splitter/): Free Windows app that splits any video into equal clips in seconds, in original quality, with cuts at natural pauses. Ideal for Status, Shorts and Reels.
